answer.rationale: Primary region write path latency is 5x target and climbing. The security patch cannot be reverted per compliance. Settlement traffic is at peak. Regional failover succeeded in March (memory_b2) with clean traffic shift and fast latency recovery. This action: (1) avoids rollback of mandatory security patch, (2) shifts heavy settlement writes to stable secondary region, (3) has proven success path in similar conditions, (4) preserves the critical security fix in place, (5) uses only one intervention slot as required. Read replicas (memory_b5) target dashboard load, not write path. Circuit breakers (memory_b4) fail fast but don't solve capacity. Capacity addition takes time during peak. Failover is the highest-confidence move given constraints.
